turns.text: I need the parcel for SC-2074 sent to a different address. I placed the order with nell.ashcombe@example.com.
The parcel has already shipped, so I can’t change the address here. I’ve passed this to a colleague to review, and they’ll take over.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer requests changing the delivery address for order SC-2074 (placed with nell.ashcombe@example.com). Policy check says the order has already shipped; a colleague must decide whether anything can be done.
